profiles.name: Auto by Mode
profiles.description: Chooses an analog listen profile from the selected/detected channel mode. NFM defaults to NOAA/NFM Clean Normal.

profiles.name: NOAA/NFM Clean Normal
profiles.notes: Best understandable NOAA/NFM baseline from Phase 3I test 06. Good starting point for NOAA, marine VHF, and many narrow FM voice channels.

profiles.name: NOAA/NFM Clean Invert-Q
profiles.notes: Alternate best understandable NOAA/NFM baseline from Phase 3I test 10. Use when Normal sounds worse.

profiles.name: Ham FM NFM
profiles.notes: Wider NFM voice profile for 2m/70cm ham FM repeaters/simplex.

profiles.name: Airband AM
profiles.notes: Analog AM listen profile for aircraft band monitoring.

profiles.name: Digital Detect Only
profiles.description: For P25/DMR/NXDN style channels. The scanner can detect/log activity, but analog Listen is disabled until a decoder path is added.
